rationale: The account now says node 3's log ends in a StopSign while leader 4's log lacks the marker and has moved past that position. The existing zero-divergence figure cannot confirm or refute that, because the harness keeps only Decided(Value) entries and compares the shorter prefix. This revision adds a direct read of the entry kinds around the reconfiguration position on both nodes, so the receipt shows whether node 3 and leader 4 hold different kinds of entry at the same index. Everything else about the seeded run is unchanged.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, node 3 ordered trace, node 4 promise diagnostics and is_reconfigured flags, run id 13. The safety event additionally records the entry kind read at indices 35, 36 and 37 on nodes 3 and 4.
assumptions: read(index) is zero-based, so index 36 is the 37th log position, which is the accepted index node 3 reports.
entry_status maps Decided and Undecided values, Trimmed, Snapshotted, StopSign and absence to distinct strings.
No snapshots or trimming are involved, so kinds are not affected by compaction.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with the node 3 ordered trace, node 4 promise diagnostics and is_reconfigured flags, including the seeded 900-action schedule, the reconfigure at action 450 and the 150-round convergence loop. The safety event gains n3_k35/n3_k36/n3_k37 and n4_k35/n4_k36/n4_k37, computed with the existing entry_status helper over nodes[2].read(i) and nodes[3].read(i) for i in 35, 36 and 37.

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.

experiment.revision_reason: Adds n3_k35, n3_k36, n3_k37, n4_k35, n4_k36 and n4_k37 to the safety event, each the kind of entry read at that index on the node (decided, undecided, trimmed, snapshotted, stopsign or none). The seeded schedule, node 3 trace, promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured fields and comparison are unchanged.
